notes.title: Steam Next Fest QA version Update
notes.notes:
Update Notes – June 11, 2025

The June 11 version was created for internal QA purposes.

The boss currently extends up to Stage 2, featuring the Yeti. Please note that the Yeti's design has not been finalized yet. We appreciate your understanding regarding this matter.

Update Details:

Tutorial enhancement

Yeti added

Spider difficulty reduced

We welcome and appreciate all feedback!
